definition: in the middle between two ends
description: A slackline stretched high across a deep gorge full of autumn trees in red, orange and yellow, with a river far below. A young woman in an orange top, black leggings and a climbing harness walks barefoot along the middle of the line with her arms spread wide, balancing about halfway between the two rocky cliff tops. A young man in a green fleece sits by the anchor on the near rock, watches her, smiles and shades his eyes, and a young woman in a mustard jacket crouches on the far side.

en.question: Where is the woman in orange balancing?

de.answer: Sie balanciert auf halbem Weg über die Schlucht.
de.question: Wo balanciert die Frau in Orange?
